text_block_list.text:
How did I end up here? I really need to
stop
daydreaming...
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
Oh, how thoughtless of me! I haven't
greeted the
Three Goddesses yet.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
I'm grateful for your guidance every day,
and I
pray for everyone's health
tomorrow as well.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик
